why: I checked both briefs against both must_not items, and neither is broken. Item 1: the verifier's Check 1 PASS needs the command to exit 0, print `{} true` and have the catch inside loadConfig. The FAIL condition is the reverse of that. Neither asks for a file name, line number or warning. The point that returning {} hides which file is broken appears only under "Advisory (not a PASS/FAIL condition)". Item 2: the builder brief says that "when JSON.parse throws, loadConfig returns {}". It does tell the builder to keep readFileSync outside the try, but that covers read errors, not parse errors. Step 6 suggests a stderr warning only as a follow-up for the PR description and says outright "do not add behaviour that the acceptance lines do not ask for." Nothing tells the builder to throw a clearer error or do anything other than return {} on a parse error.
